title: Planned double-blind DNA test of the Peruvian bodies
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Planned double-blind DNA test of the Peruvian bodies, about 2025 at Peru, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he's DNA testing it with these like independent aerospace contractors that and they're going to do some double blind stuff so no cheating allow.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2025 a man named Michael Mazzola, connected to a documentary called This Is Not a Hoax, was arranging DNA tests on strange bodies from Peru that some people present as possibly non-human. Michels says the tests would be run with independent aerospace contractors and done "double blind," meaning the testers would not know which sample was which, so that no one could cheat.
